description: Two new open-access papers not used in prior benchmark construction or fixes, covering visual scientific retrieval and PDF multimodal RAG.
reclassification_reason: The first isolated Hybrid retrieval diagnostic hit both target documents and all marked pages/table numbers, but only 4/12 cases had complete required-fact coverage at @50 (macro 0.350, micro 0.300). Failures concentrated in wide-table and table-field coverage, so this set is no longer an unseen confirmation set.
freeze_policy: Freeze the cases and gold facts before retrieval diagnostics. Any implementation or prompt change motivated by this set reclassifies it as development-regression and requires a new unseen set.
